rootCause: The strict manufacturing pipeline proved file and sourcing authenticity but had no topology-specific semantic gate, allowing a dual-bus CAN gateway request to reuse and accept the single-bus STM32 CAN controller unchanged.
fixSummary: Recognize dual-bus CAN intent in the catalog adapter and construct a dedicated production topology with two SN65HVD230 transceivers, two protected and terminated CAN channel pairs, independent CAN1/CAN2 nets, and separate field connectors.
regressions: dual-bus CAN gateway has two independently named CAN physical channels
never: Treat ERC/DRC zero as proof that requested channel multiplicity exists
Rename a single-bus design to satisfy a dual-bus request
